classification: post-result robustness audit frozen before calibration and permutation outcomes were inspected

constraints.features: identical to existing baseline and baseline-plus-neural models
constraints.tuning: identical to existing analyses and confined to training data

subject_level_prediction_rows.ds007648: re-run the existing leave-one-subject-out pipeline and retain trial predictions; aggregate loss within held-out participant
subject_level_prediction_rows.ds006780: re-run the existing 10x10 repeated K-fold pipeline; average each participant's 10 held-out predictions before subject-level evaluation

loss_increment: neural-model loss minus baseline-model loss; negative values favor neural features

null_distribution.method: two-sided paired sign-flip test of participant-level loss increments

calibration.continuous_outcomes: participant-level OLS of observed outcome on held-out prediction, reported as intercept, slope, and R-squared
calibration.binary_trial_outcome_ds007648: GEE logistic calibration of observed correctness on the logit of held-out probability, clustered by participant
calibration.interpretation: descriptive; calibration does not replace comparative held-out loss

outer_unit_summary: fraction of participants with lower neural-model loss
median and interquartile range of paired loss increment
minimum and maximum leave-one-participant-out mean increment

prohibitions: no threshold chosen from observed audit results
no claim that failure to improve prediction proves absence of a brain-behavior relationship
